primary.label: Beat + Maintain (often a fade)
primary.stance: Conditional — fade gap-up if pre-runup was sharp; otherwise small follow
primary.entry: If pre-runup >5% in 5d AND gap-up >3%: SHORT/skip-long the open, fade to VWAP. Else: small long on opening 30-min consolidation breakout, exit T+2 close.
primary.stoploss: Long: 1.5% below entry. Fade: above gap-up high.
primary.target: Long: fill of any gap-up, no chase. Fade: pre-result close.
primary.rationale: Most common 'sell on news' setup. Beat is fully priced if smart money already ran the stock; maintained guidance gives no fresh catalyst.
falsification: Concall flags an unscheduled positive catalyst (large order, capex announcement)
Sector beats broadly the same day → tide lifts even fade setups

plan.label: Beat + Raise (strongest)
plan.stance: Follow the break — primary swing setup

plan.target: +5–8% over T+2 to T+5; partial out at +4% if 1-day momentum stalls

primary.label: Beat + Maintain (often a fade)
primary.stance: Conditional — fade gap-up if pre-runup was sharp; otherwise small follow
primary.entry: If pre-runup >5% in 5d AND gap-up >3%: SHORT/skip-long the open, fade to VWAP. Else: small long on opening 30-min consolidation breakout, exit T+2 close.
primary.stoploss: Long: 1.5% below entry. Fade: above gap-up high.
primary.target: Long: fill of any gap-up, no chase. Fade: pre-result close.
primary.rationale: Most common 'sell on news' setup. Beat is fully priced if smart money already ran the stock; maintained guidance gives no fresh catalyst.
falsification: Concall flags an unscheduled positive catalyst (large order, capex announcement)
Sector beats broadly the same day → tide lifts even fade setups

plan.label: Beat + Raise (strongest)
plan.stance: Follow the break — primary swing setup
plan.entry: Buy on T+1 close after concall, OR on first pullback to opening 30-min low if it holds
plan.stoploss: Below T+1 opening 30-min low (~1.5–2.5% below entry)
plan.target: +5–8% over T+2 to T+5; partial out at +4% if 1-day momentum stalls
plan.rationale: Beat + guidance raise = analyst PT upgrades T+1–T+3, sustained drift. Strongest cell in the matrix.
falsification: Sector rolls over the same week

primary.label: Beat + Maintain (often a fade)

plan.label: Miss + Raise (mixed)

plan.stoploss: Below T+1 low

primary.label: Beat + Maintain (often a fade)
primary.stance: Conditional — fade gap-up if pre-runup was sharp; otherwise small follow
primary.entry: If pre-runup >5% in 5d AND gap-up >3%: SHORT/skip-long the open, fade to VWAP. Else: small long on opening 30-min consolidation breakout, exit T+2 close.
primary.stoploss: Long: 1.5% below entry. Fade: above gap-up high.
primary.target: Long: fill of any gap-up, no chase. Fade: pre-result close.
primary.rationale: Most common 'sell on news' setup. Beat is fully priced if smart money already ran the stock; maintained guidance gives no fresh catalyst.
falsification: Concall flags an unscheduled positive catalyst (large order, capex announcement)
Sector beats broadly the same day → tide lifts even fade setups

plan.label: Beat + Raise (strongest)

plan.stoploss: Below T+1 opening 30-min low (~1.5–2.5% below entry)
plan.target: +5–8% over T+2 to T+5; partial out at +4% if 1-day momentum stalls

falsification: Sector rolls over the same week

primary.entry: If pre-runup >5% in 5d AND gap-up >3%: SHORT/skip-long the open, fade to VWAP. Else: small long on opening 30-min consolidation breakout, exit T+2 close.
primary.stoploss: Long: 1.5% below entry. Fade: above gap-up high.
primary.target: Long: fill of any gap-up, no chase. Fade: pre-result close.
primary.rationale: Most common 'sell on news' setup. Beat is fully priced if smart money already ran the stock; maintained guidance gives no fresh catalyst.
falsification: Concall flags an unscheduled positive catalyst (large order, capex announcement)
Sector beats broadly the same day → tide lifts even fade setups

plan.label: Beat + Raise (strongest)
plan.stance: Follow the break — primary swing setup
plan.entry: Buy on T+1 close after concall, OR on first pullback to opening 30-min low if it holds
plan.stoploss: Below T+1 opening 30-min low (~1.5–2.5% below entry)
plan.target: +5–8% over T+2 to T+5; partial out at +4% if 1-day momentum stalls
plan.rationale: Beat + guidance raise = analyst PT upgrades T+1–T+3, sustained drift. Strongest cell in the matrix.
falsification: Sector rolls over the same week
Macro shock (FOMC/RBI/geopolitical) within T+5
Block-deal flow reveals a large institutional seller post-print

plan.label: Beat + Cut (the trap)
plan.stance: Fade — short the open or sit out longs
plan.entry: Short the gap-up open; if no gap, short the rejection at any opening rally
plan.stoploss: Above gap-up high; 2% above entry as a backstop
plan.target: VWAP first, then pre-result close if momentum shifts
plan.rationale: Headline beat looks good but cut guidance flips the forward narrative. Stock fades hard once the concall lands. The 'beat' alone is a trap for retail.
falsification: Cut is one-time / FX-related and management calls out a quick recovery on the call

primary.label: Beat + Maintain (often a fade)
primary.stance: Conditional — fade gap-up if pre-runup was sharp; otherwise small follow
primary.entry: If pre-runup >5% in 5d AND gap-up >3%: SHORT/skip-long the open, fade to VWAP. Else: small long on opening 30-min consolidation breakout, exit T+2 close.
primary.stoploss: Long: 1.5% below entry. Fade: above gap-up high.
primary.target: Long: fill of any gap-up, no chase. Fade: pre-result close.
primary.rationale: Most common 'sell on news' setup. Beat is fully priced if smart money already ran the stock; maintained guidance gives no fresh catalyst.
falsification: Concall flags an unscheduled positive catalyst (large order, capex announcement)

plan.label: Beat + Raise (strongest)

falsification: Sector rolls over the same week

primary.label: Beat + Maintain (often a fade)
primary.stance: Conditional — fade gap-up if pre-runup was sharp; otherwise small follow

paragraphs: IPL reports Q4 FY26 in 14d. Our model expects the result to land INLINE, with 59% confidence (V1 cap is 65% — see methodology). Strongest input: SWS snowflake 13/30; reinforced by neutral runup vs sector.

Component breakdown (49/100 composite): pulling toward INLINE: SWS snowflake 13/30; neutral runup vs sector; no trajectory data. No strong opposing signal — INLINE reflects balanced inputs, not absent ones. Sector Materials momentum acts as the prevailing tide; treat any single-stock thesis as conditional on it not flipping mid-week.
1-day post-result range: bull +5%, base +0%, bear -5% (no live price anchor — SWS row not present). Earnings are binary events — size to survive bear, not maximise bull.
falsification_triggers: Reported EPS or revenue surprises by ≥ 5% in either direction
Guidance is materially raised or cut
Pre-result block-deal flow flips heavily institutional in 48h before

primary.label: Inline + Maintain (skip)
primary.rationale: No catalyst either way. Stock often drifts down because the 'inline' result resolves uncertainty without new positive news. Not worth the screen time.
falsification: Surprise sector tailwind in the days following
Block-deal flow reveals an institutional buyer post-print

plan.label: Inline + Raise (underrated bullish)
plan.stance: Buy — best 2–3 day swing in the matrix
plan.entry: Buy at T+1 close OR on T+1 morning pullback to opening 30-min low
plan.stoploss: Below T+1 opening 30-min low
plan.target: +3–5% over T+2 to T+3; analysts re-rate on the forward bump
plan.rationale: Market underreacts because the headline is 'inline' — boring. Forward guidance bump is the real signal; analyst PTs follow. Cleanest cell for a 2–3 day hold.
falsification: Guidance bump is one-time / FY-restatement, not organic
Sector reverses

plan.label: Inline + Maintain (skip)
plan.stance: Skip — no edge; chop likely
plan.entry: Stand aside
plan.stoploss: n/a
plan.target: n/a
plan.rationale: No catalyst either way. Stock often drifts down because the 'inline' result resolves uncertainty without new positive news. Not worth the screen time.
falsification: Surprise sector tailwind in the days following

plan.label: Inline + Cut (strong negative drift)
plan.stance: Short or stay flat — 5–10 day downside drift
plan.entry: Short on T+1 bounce to VWAP, OR enter on T+2 if T+1 closes red
plan.stoploss: Above T+1 high; 2.5% above entry as backstop
plan.target: -4–6% over T+2 to T+5
plan.rationale: Forward downgrade is the real signal; the 'inline' headline buys the stock 24–48h before the analyst-PT cuts hit. This is the post-earnings drift in negative form.
falsification: Macro tailwind (rate cut, oil crash) shifts the sector
Activist or strategic announcement during the drift window
